newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ENGLAND V MEXICO FRIENDLY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TEAMS FOR ENGLAND V MEXICO FRIENDLY.

text.p: Teams for the friendly international between England and Mexico at Wembley on Saturday:

England - 1-David James, 2-Martin Keown, 3-Stuart Pearce, 4- David Batty, 5-Gareth Southgate, 6-Graeme Le Saux, 7-Robert Lee, 8-Paul Ince (captain), 9-Robbie Fowler, 10-Teddy Sheringham, 11-Steve McManaman.

Mexico - 25-Aldolfo Rios, 13-Pavel Pardo, 2-Claudio Suarez, 5-Duilio Davino, 7-Ramon Ramirez, 16-Alberto Coyote, 18-Enrique Alfaro, 17-Benjamin Galindo, 8-Alberto Garcia Aspe (captain), 27-Carlos Hermosillo, 11-Luis Roberto Alves.
